children.label: Reload settings file when changed
children.description: Automatically reload the active settings file when it changes on disk. When disabled, external changes take effect on the next launch. Changes made in this editor still apply immediately.

children.label: When the current file is deleted
children.description: Choose when the viewer leaves an image that has been deleted. Internally means deleted by OIViewer, while externally means deleted by another application. External file monitoring is available on Windows.

children.label: When the current file changes
children.description: Choose whether to ignore changes, ask before reloading, reload when the viewer is active, or reload immediately in the background. External file monitoring is available on Windows.

children.label: Maximum zoom
children.description: Limits manual zoom as a scale relative to the original image. If this conflicts with the minimum image size, the minimum takes precedence.

children.label: Refinement delay
children.description: Time in milliseconds to wait after zooming or panning stops before refining a large image. A shorter delay updates detail sooner but can do more work during navigation.

children.label: Refinement work budget
children.description: Controls how much image data is processed around the visible area. The budget is 2 raised to this value, so increasing it by one doubles the budget and may use more processing time.

children.label: Refinement reuse tolerance
children.description: Controls how much the requested sampling resolution may change before cached detail is rebuilt. For example, 0.25 allows approximately 25 percent more or 20 percent less detail.

children.label: Refinement buffer target
children.description: Target size in bytes for the refined pixel buffer, including optional detail around the visible area. The visible image can exceed this target when it is needed for display.

children.label: Refinement detail threshold
children.description: Start generating detailed image data when one pixel of the lower resolution preview spans at least this many screen pixels. Lower values request detail sooner.

children.label: Minimum image size
children.description: Limits how far manual zoom can shrink an image. The shortest image dimension stays at least this many pixels, unless the original image is smaller.

children.label: Slideshow interval
children.description: Time in milliseconds between slideshow images. For example, 2000 shows each image for about two seconds. Zero stops the slideshow timer.

children.label: Quick browse delay
children.description: Minimum delay in milliseconds between repeated navigation steps while browsing quickly. Larger values slow down repeated image changes.

children.label: Horizontal pan margin
children.description: Controls how far an image may be panned past the left or right edge. A value of 0.25 allows a margin equal to one quarter of the image or viewport width.

children.label: Vertical pan margin
children.description: Controls how far an image may be panned past the top or bottom edge. A value of 0.25 allows a margin equal to one quarter of the image or viewport height.

children.label: Minimum frame interval
children.description: Shortest allowed display time for an animation frame, in milliseconds. Increasing it limits the maximum playback speed.

children.label: Slow playback frame interval
children.description: Target duration in milliseconds used to determine the slowest playback speed. The animation frame timings and slow speed percentage also affect that limit.

children.label: Slow playback speed
children.description: Reference percentage used to determine the slowest animation speed. For example, 1 means one percent of the original speed, subject to the slow frame interval.

children.label: Dead zone radius
children.description: Distance in pixels around the point where auto scroll starts. Moving the pointer inside this area does not scroll the image.

children.label: Inner speed factor
children.description: Controls how quickly auto scroll speed grows just outside the dead zone. It is used as an exponent in the distance to speed calculation.

children.label: Outer speed factor
children.description: Controls how quickly auto scroll speed grows farther from the starting point. It is used as an exponent in the distance to speed calculation.

children.label: Speed factor range
children.description: Distance in pixels over which the auto scroll calculation changes from the inner speed factor to the outer speed factor.

children.label: Maximum auto scroll speed
children.description: Limits auto scroll speed in pixels per second, even when the pointer moves far from the starting point.
